newsitem.title: UK: Next says current yr retail sales up 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Next says current yr retail sales up 19 pct.

text.p: UK fashion retailer Next Plc on Wednesday said retail sales were up 19 percent since the start of its current financial year and sales from its mail order business the Next Directory were up 38 percent from the previous year.
The group reported pre-tax profits of 158.8 million pounds in the year to February 1, up from 141.9 million the year before, and a total dividend of 15 pence per share, up from 11.75 pence.
"Taken together, sales for the Next brand are currently 24 percent ahead of last year," chairman Lord Wolfson of Sunningdale said in a statement accompanying its results.
The results showed pretax profits up 25 percent and near the top of analysts' forecasts for between 155.0 million stg and 159.0 million stg.
"I am pleased to report that Next has made significant progress in the year," said Wolfson, commenting on retail sales. "We continued our controlled expansion of selling space".
The group opened 21 new stores and extended seven of its existing stores last year, while closing seven. It anticipates adding approximately 75,000 square feet of selling spare in 1997.
